map.营业 8 小时（480 分钟）、平均用餐 50 分钟 → 理论最大翻台率 = 4: 8 business hours (480 minutes), average dining 50 minutes → theoretical max turnover = 480 ÷ 50 = 9.6; seat occupancy 75% → actual turnover = 9.6 × 0.75 = 7.2 (graded "excellent"). 20 tables → 144 table turns a day; 3 guests per table → 432 covers; average ticket 80 CNY → daily revenue about 34,560 CNY. If average dining time is cut to 45 minutes, theoretical turnover rises to 10.67 and actual to 8.0, and daily revenue grows to about 38,400 CNY.
map.翻台率多少算好？: What turnover rate counts as good?
map.工具按实际翻台率评级：≥4 优秀、≥3 良好、≥2 一般、<2 偏低。快餐与火锅: The tool grades the actual turnover rate: ≥4 excellent, ≥3 good, ≥2 average, <2 low. Reasonable ranges differ greatly between fast food and hot pot, so the more practical approach is to compare against your own store history and read the trend rather than an absolute number.
map.上座率怎么估？: How do I estimate seat occupancy?
map.上座率是实际开台桌次占理论最大桌次的比例，可用历史同时段开台记录估算。没有数据时: Seat occupancy is actual opened table turns divided by the theoretical maximum; it can be estimated from historical opened-table records for the same time slot. Without data, start with 60-70% and back-calibrate from actual revenue.

map.理论最大翻台率 = 营业总分钟 ÷ 平均用餐时间: Theoretical maximum turnover = total operating minutes ÷ average dining time
map.实际翻台率 = 理论最大 × 上座率: Actual turnover = theoretical maximum × occupancy rate
map.日接待桌数 = ⌊实际翻台率 × 桌数⌋: Tables served per day = ⌊actual turnover × table count⌋
map.日接待人次 = ⌊日接待桌数 × 每桌人数⌋: Guests served per day = ⌊tables served per day × guests per table⌋
map.预估日营业额 = 日接待人次 × 客单价: Estimated daily revenue = guests served per day × average spend per guest
map.翻台率评级：≥4 优秀｜≥3 良好｜≥2 一般｜其他 偏低: Turnover rating: ≥4 excellent | ≥3 good | ≥2 average | otherwise low
map.可视化按 ÷5 归一化条宽，优秀线固定 80%（4.0 次）: Bar widths are normalized by ÷5, with the excellence line fixed at 80% (4.0 turns)
map.用餐时间对照表：30/40/45/50/60/75/90 分钟逐档重算: Dining time comparison table: recalculated for 30/40/45/50/60/75/90 minutes
map.优化建议：平均用餐 >60 分钟压缩出餐与离座引导: Optimization: with an average dining time >60 minutes, speed up service and guide guests to leave
map.上座率 <70% 引流与午市特惠｜翻台 <2 增加预约制与翻桌流程管控: Occupancy <70%: drive traffic and offer lunch specials | turnover <2: add reservations and tighten table reset control
map.高峰期设用餐时限（如 90 分钟）平衡体验与效率: Set a dining time limit at peak hours (e.g. 90 minutes) to balance experience and efficiency
